name: Cable triceps kickback
cue: Upper arm still and level; straighten the elbow.
research: Standing one-arm cable triceps kickback, right arm working, the low pulley in front and to the right. Design values from the standard technique description (hinged forward with a flat back, the upper arm held still along the torso with the elbow at the back, only the forearm moving), not a measured trial. Feet hip width on a plate, knees bent 40, hip flexion 75, trunk 55 deg forward as one line (pelvis 50, lumbar and thorax 5 together), ankle 15 deg dorsiflexed so the soles stay flat, the head in line with the spine; the left hand rests on the left thigh above the knee. The right upper arm stays still, 16 deg past the trunk line (shoulder extension) and 14 deg out from the sagittal plane so the hand passes beside the hip, about 19 deg below level, while the elbow goes from 90 to 5 deg: the forearm hangs forward and down at the start and ends level with the upper arm, the fist 0.11 H behind the hip joint. A D-handle rides in the fist (bone-attached, so the hand cannot slip) and its triangle swivels about the grip bar to point along the cable (hinge dswing). The pulley is low (0.075 H, in a fork on the column's base), 0.5 H in front of the stance and 0.22 H to the right, so the cable runs forward and down from the hand (46 deg below horizontal at the start, 40 deg at the end; the moment arm against the cable, the sine of the angle between the forearm and the cable, is 0.28 at the start, 0.93 mid-range and 0.94 at the end). Cable 1:1 to the stack. Geometry: design/cableB/kb.mjs.

targets.note: design values (standard technique), not a measured trial: the trunk and the upper arm stay still, only the elbow moves

camera.note: Research view of the triceps work, the right profile (az 100, el 5), turned 25 deg toward the back and raised 13 (az 125, el 18, 29 deg off it): the working right arm is the near one and, held level behind the hinged trunk, its back faces up and out, so the glow lies along the back of the upper arm and the forearm swings back to straight above the hip; the low column and the cable stand in front of the figure and stay in frame (fitMachine true).
